intro: A quieter news day: the big story is Bitcoin's own protocol drama, with the BIP-110 breakaway chain stalling out after two blocks.

items.headline: Nvidia-led security alliance ships first proposals, open-sources an AI agent-harness project
items.summary: A week after forming with 120+ members, the Nvidia-spearheaded Open Secure AI Alliance published its first working proposals for confidential incident reporting on AI agents and open-sourced NOOA, an agent-harness project meant to make agent behavior easier to test, trace, and govern.
items.why: Concrete standards and tooling for auditing agent behavior are still rare; this is one of the first industry-wide attempts.

items.headline: Security researchers find a supply-chain flaw in Google's Agent Development Kit
items.summary: Pillar Security disclosed an exploit in Google's Python Agent Development Kit that could let a malicious tool or sub-agent compromise other agents and their dependency chain within the same harness.
items.why: A reminder that multi-agent frameworks widen the attack surface beyond single-model prompt injection.

items.headline: GitHub Copilot's weekly update adds session management and model transparency
items.summary: This week's Copilot release lets developers manage multiple concurrent sessions from a sidebar, shows which model handled each completed Auto request along with credit and cache details, and adds a /side command to explore a parallel question without losing context.

items.headline: DeepSeek ships V4-Flash-0731, an MIT-licensed coding and agent model
items.summary: DeepSeek's official V4-Flash-0731 release keeps the 284B-parameter, 13B-active mixture-of-experts architecture from its April preview but adds a fine-tuning pass that lifted its agentic and coding scores past the larger V4-Pro, at a fraction of the cost of comparable proprietary models.
items.why: A free, open-weight model now beats DeepSeek's own flagship on coding and tool-use benchmarks.

items.headline: Mistral open-sources Shieldstral, a compact multimodal safety classifier
items.summary: Shieldstral is a 3B-parameter, Apache 2.0-licensed moderation model that accepts plain-language policies at inference time to judge prompts, responses, and images for safety, without retraining, and runs on a single 16GB GPU.

items.headline: Node.js 26.7.0 adds an HSM-backed key loader and updates its cert store
items.summary: The latest Current release adds a STORE loader interface for loading private keys directly from hardware security modules, updates the bundled root certificate store to NSS 3.125, and bumps npm to 11.19.0.

items.headline: pnpm 11.5 adds hoisting limits and fixes a peer-resolution hang
items.summary: The release adds a hoistingLimits setting to control how far dependencies hoist under nodeLinker: hoisted, replaces its interactive-prompt library to fix a scrolling bug, and fixes pnpm hanging when aliased installs pull in transitive packages with mutual peer cycles.

items.headline: Garbage SQLite CVEs expose cracks in the vulnerability-reporting pipeline
items.summary: Six SQLite vulnerabilities published as a batch turned out to be baseless, yet still landed in the National Vulnerability Database with CISA enrichment, underscoring how AI-assisted vulnerability reports are straining an already backlogged CVE pipeline.
items.why: Teams that auto-triage on CVE severity risk chasing phantom vulnerabilities.

items.headline: Bitcoin's BIP-110 breakaway chain stalls after mining just two blocks
items.summary: The minority chain created by BIP-110 supporters, who wanted to temporarily curb non-financial data in transactions, ground to a halt roughly eight hours after its mandatory-signaling launch, mining only two blocks while the main chain advanced by 48. Support among miners never exceeded 2.53%, far short of the 55% needed to activate without a split.
items.why: One of the most consequential Bitcoin soft-fork attempts in years has effectively failed at launch.

items.headline: Developer warns holders who sell BIP-110 fork coins risk losing real bitcoin
items.summary: A Bitcoin developer cautioned that people who received coins on the stalled BIP-110 chain could lose their actual BTC if they sell those fork coins carelessly, since transactions on the minority chain can be replayed on the main chain without proper safeguards.

items.headline: Whales accumulate $1.2 billion in bitcoin as price holds near $65,000
items.summary: Wallets holding between 10 and 10,000 BTC have added more than 20,000 BTC since July 29, even as bitcoin's price stayed range-bound below $65,000.
